_why_a_fixture_and_not_a_cross_call: ⛔ A TEST THAT RAN THE JS LANE FROM PYTHON AND COMPARED WOULD BE GREEN WHEN BOTH LANES ARE WRONG TOGETHER. It also means the JS suite catches a JS regression without a node subprocess, which is the difference between a rail that runs on every push and one that runs when somebody remembers.
